a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both cover the same 1,500 samples; an exposure row must carry whichever value the code path that builds its ExecutionPlan computes.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.
a2t_calibration_population: The RELEASE's own populations of tiers 2, 5 and 8, sampled: for every query_* directory of each tier, the first recording the released loader resolves -- on tier2_parametric (3,160 directories) and tier5_needle (2,146) the shipped speaker with the lowest speaker_idx, i.e. the manifest row with the lowest id; on tier8_intent_blending (821) the single mixed.wav the directory ships, whose manifest row carries speaker_idx null. 500 of each tier's population are then drawn uniformly without replacement with seed 20260803, giving 1,500 rows with tier as the stratum. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_tier258_official_population_roster.py; roster receipt above; the receipt carries the directory-by-directory replay of each tier's released loader (tier 2: 3,160 agreements, 0 disagreements, 0 unresolved; tier 5: 2,146 agreements, 0 disagreements, 0 unresolved under the documented stale-path fallback; tier 8: 821 directories each shipping exactly the one mixed.wav the loader names). Domain mix of the draws: tier2 smart_home 370 / wearables 108 / smart_car 22 (population 2500 / 550 / 110); tier5 smart_home 368 / wearables 91 / smart_car 41 (1590 / 390 / 166); tier8 wearables 211 / smart_home 195 / smart_car 94 (333 / 333 / 155). Overlap with the frozen 400, by query: 12 of the 50 tier-2 queries, 13 of the 50 tier-5 queries and 32 of the 50 tier-8 queries; by sample id: 6 / 7 / 32, because tiers 2 and 5 of the frozen 400 carry mixed speakers while tier 8 has only one recording per query.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: 1,455 of the 1,500 sample ids are NEW to the immutable D1 identity closure and are carried by the additive receipt named above (docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-a2t-tier258-official-population-1500.json, schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1). The other 45 (6 tier-2, 7 tier-5, 32 tier-8) are already inside docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json as part of the frozen 400, and contracts.gate_media_identity refuses a supplement that duplicates a base D1 sample, so they are verified against the parent manifest byte for byte and skipped. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_tier1_official_population_d1_supplement.py, which is roster-parameterised and reused unchanged.
a2t_calibration_scoring_identity: 1,423 of the 1,500 sample ids are new to data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe and enter it through docs/receipts/probe-samples/a2t-tier258-official-population-1500.json; the other 77 already resolve through r1-audio2tool-sample.json (45) and the two 104-row post-seal AgentLoop scoring receipts (20 + 12), and a probe-sample receipt that repeated them would be refused as a duplicate. Without that receipt a2t-toolcall-official and a2t-toolcall-v2 refuse to score the roster at all.
a2t_calibration_exposure: Fresh discovery identities inside an already-admitted discovery carrier, prepared without model, network, tokenizer, scorer or audio-decoding contact. This fragment grants no contact authority; docs/readiness/2026-09-04-a2t-tier258-official-population-v1-preregistration.md and the exposure ledger do.
a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split the calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe.
a2t_calibration_longest_row_note: The longest row of the whole 1,500 is tier5_needle:003555 at 32.43375 s, against the tier-1 official-population roster's 654.6325 s release defect. Under the mmproj encoder's one-second window rule n_tokens = 13 * ceil(audio_seconds) it costs 429 speech tokens, so the worst request needs 3,581 text + 429 speech + 256 completion + 2 special = 4,268 tokens and this roster serves the ordinary official-protocol raw geometry -c 49152 -np 3 rather than the tier-1 cell's -np 2.
